in the Newtonian limit of the Einstein equations, the scalar and vector perturbations of the metric can be consistently neglected only if one neglects the Euler equation, which is the equation describing the dynamics of the velocity field.

the Newtonian system for a pressureless (dust) fluid can be derived from the full Einstein system of equations in Poisson gauge in a double expansion, which allows to use Newtonian intuition in cosmology.
